stated_not_recorded.subject: Juan Castro: first Dodgers exit, 2009 re-signing, December 2010 re-signing, 2011 retirement
stated_not_recorded.why_not_recorded: Recording the 2000 trade needs the observation that Kenny Lutz never reached the majors (his return has no WAR and no Baseball-Reference id), and dodgers_control_observations is sealed: a row is never deleted, so a migration that writes one cannot be rolled back to its exact pre-053 state. The 2009 and December 2010 signings cannot be recorded without the 2000 exit (their intervals would overlap the 1991 one). A reviewed batch that accepts a retraction-based rollback can record all four from this evidence.
